matchup_notes: Kansas City has won three straight, including a 34-7 Week 11 win over Arizona.
Since its Week 7 bye, Buffalo's defense has held opponents to 10, 6, 12 and 9 points in its last four games.
Patrick Mahomes threw for 324 yards and three touchdowns against Arizona; it was his second straight game with at least 300 passing yards and three touchdowns.
